{{- /*
llms-full.txt: the entire documentation corpus in one plain-text markdown
file (the GitBook/Prefect "llms-full" convention), so an AI agent can fetch
everything in a single request instead of crawling.

Generated only for the home page (see [outputs] home in hugo.toml). Mirrors
the section tree used by the concise /llms.txt index (theme template) and
honours "llms: false" front matter to opt a section or page out, and
"llmsFull: false" to keep a large generated catalog out of this file while
leaving it in the concise /llms.txt index. Individual pages remain available
as raw markdown by appending ".md" to their URL.
*/ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description | default "" }}

Every page below is also available individually as markdown by appending
".md" to its URL. This file is the full corpus; /llms.txt is the concise
index.

{{ end }}

{{- if $rootPages }}
## Root Pages

{{ template "llms-full-page" dict "context" . "level" 3 }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- $omitted := where (where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false) "Params.llmsFull" "eq" false }}
{{- if $omitted }}
## Omitted sections

The following sections are large generated catalogs and are intentionally
left out of this file. Fetch them directly when needed:

- {{ .Title }}: {{ .Permalink }} (raw markdown at {{ .Permalink }}index.md)
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
